title: Customer service
subtitle: Agents that serve strangers — answering only from knowledge bases and service notes. High-risk capabilities are never registered.

trust.lead: A fixed safety boundary that configuration cannot widen
trust.readonly: Three read-only tools only: knowledge search / knowledge read / service notes
trust.locked: Terminal / files / computer / browser capabilities are never registered

create.title: New agent
create.hint: Pick a name — configure the rest later
create.defaultsHint: After creating you can set the model, knowledge bases, voice and concurrency ceiling.

empty.title: No agents yet
empty.desc: Create an agent, mount knowledge bases and a service policy, then bind a channel bot to it on the desktop so it can safely greet visitors.

fields.name: Name
fields.providerSheetHint: Only providers with chat models are listed

fields.noModels: This provider has no chat-capable model
fields.noKnowledgeBases: No knowledge bases yet — create one on the desktop.

fields.greetingPlaceholder: Opening line when a visitor says hello
fields.personaPlaceholder: Tone and persona, e.g. patient, concise, fact-first
fields.servicePolicyHint: Goes into the system prompt and bounds the answers
fields.maxConcurrentHint: Visitors served at once (1–64); one visitor is always serial

detail.enabledHint: Serving visitors on the bound bots
detail.disabledHint: Paused — no new visitors are served
detail.deleteConfirm: Deleting this agent also deletes its channel bindings, visitor dialogues and private notes. This cannot be undone.
detail.notFound: This agent does not exist or was deleted

bots.domainHint: Customer service has its own channel bots, fully separate from companion channels.
bots.noBots: No customer-service bots yet — create one on the desktop.
bots.noneBoundHere: No bot is bound to this agent, so visitors cannot reach it.
bots.desktopOnly: Create, bind and unbind on the desktop. Once bound, every visitor message on that bot goes to this agent (strangers need no pairing code).

notes.empty: FAQs, scripts and business facts live here. The agent quotes them read-only and never executes them.

notes.sharedHint: Share with every agent (unchecked = this agent only)
notes.scopeLocked: Scope cannot be changed after creation
notes.tapToEdit: Tap to edit content and kind
notes.deleteConfirm: Delete this note? The agent will stop quoting it.

dialogues.pollHint: Visitor dialogues are not pushed live — pull down or tap refresh to update.
